title: Keto Chinese BBQ Pork Bao
description: A keto version of the classic Chinese BBQ pork bao. This recipe is low in carbs and high in fat.

ingredients.name: Pork belly
ingredients.notes: Make sure to get a piece with a good balance of meat and fat.

ingredients.name: Chinese five-spice
ingredients.notes: This spice blend is a key component of Chinese BBQ sauce.

ingredients.name: Siu bao sauce
ingredients.notes: You can make your own or use store-bought.

ingredients.name: Char siu
ingredients.notes: This is a type of Chinese BBQ sauce. You can use either store-bought or homemade.

ingredients.name: Almond flour
ingredients.notes: To make the keto bao dough.

ingredients.name: Coconut oil
ingredients.notes: To cook the pork and the bao.

instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the Chinese five-spice and siu bao sauce.
Rub the spice mixture all over the pork belly, making sure to coat it evenly.
Place the pork belly in a baking dish and roast for 20 minutes.
While the pork is cooking, make the keto bao dough by mixing together the almond flour, eggs, and coconut oil.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 4-6 equal pieces, depending on how large you want your bao to be.
Roll out each piece of dough into a thin circle.
Place a piece of the pork belly in the center of each dough circle.
Fold the dough over the pork to form a half-moon shape and press the edges together to seal the bao.
Place the bao on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush the tops of the bao with char siu and bake for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the dough is golden brown.
Garnish with green onions and serve immediately.
